desc: Ideate and select the greedy lexicographic unranking approach.
Implement the greedy lexicographic unranking solution with capped factorials, a `count_suffix` feasibility helper, first-position handling, and return `[]` when `k` exceeds the total.
Validate the implementation against the provided examples and brute-force all alternating permutations for small `n`, including odd/even `n`, boundary `k`, and capped factorial cases.
